notes.title: NEW UPDATE! Mouse and Keyboard controls + Localization
notes.content: [p]Dear Bug Hunters, we did many small updates in terms of gameplay and UI, but the most important things are:[/p][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][p]You can play the game in the following languages:[/p][p]English [/p][p]Italian[/p][p]Spanish[/p][p]French[/p][p]German[/p][p]Japanese[/p][p][/p][h2]Play with Mouse and Keyboard[/h2][p][/p][p]You are a true pc gamer, you hate controllers and their weird little thumbsticks, don't you? We heard your cry for help, and now you can enjoy the game with a mouse and keyboard![/p]

notes.title: Small Fix - Polished LVL 02
notes.content: - Cleaned up LVL 02 design according to player feedback

notes.title: SMALL FIX: Achievements Update
notes.content: The game now runs on UE5.6 and the achievements have been optimized for the new system.

notes.title: Camera Update! The code evolved and now Default can move the camera around.
notes.content:
[h2][b]Camera UPDATE! [/b] [/h2]

You can now move the camera with the RIGHT THUMBSTICK of your controller to have a better idea of your surroundings.
This is the answer to the common question in every platformer:
"Do I die if I jump down there? Or it's a hidden path?"
Now you'll have more clues to decide.

notes.title: Small update for upcoming event
notes.content: A small adjustment to the game achievement system. This update is needed to accommodate a surprise that will be announced next week.

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Death Count Fix
notes.content:
Hi NPCs! In this update, I fixed a small bug (a real one).
There's a secret item in the game that allows you to keep track of how many times you died. The counter was not correct, but now it is.
Good luck, bug hunters!
